annotations.title: Check a formula (IFRA and EU allergens)

description: Use this when the user has a perfume or accord formula, pasted or drafted earlier in this conversation, and wants to know whether it is IFRA compliant, how much of the finished product it may be, which line to reduce, or which EU allergens the label must declare. Checks IFRA Category 4 (fine fragrance) at the concentration the user chooses, finds the highest safe concentration and says how far to reduce a line that is over a limit. Give the formula as pasted text (one material per line with an amount) or as structured lines, every line in grams or every line in percent. Lines that match no catalog material are listed and not counted. Does not save anything and does not change the amounts. Returns a link that opens the formula in PerfuMate. For one material's limit use get_material; for a starting recipe use find_starting_formula.

concentrationPct.description: How much of the finished product the formula is, e.g. 20 for an eau de parfum.

formula.description: The formula as text, one line per material, e.g. "Hedione 4 g" or "Ambroxan 10% in DPG 2 g".

dilutionPct.description: Strength of the bottle used, e.g. 10 for a 10% dilution. Omit for neat.

material.description: Material name as written, e.g. "Iso E Super".
